newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU cereals committee to discuss Portuguese maize.
newsitem.headline: EU cereals committee to discuss Portuguese maize.

text.p: The European Union's cereals management committee is expected to discuss the import of 150,000 tonnes of maize into Portugal on Thursday, an EU member state official said on Tuesday.
"The item has been listed for discussion," the official said.
The committee is also scheduled to deal with export refunds for processed products in addition to the usual weekly tenders.
